title: An immune world model for multiscale forecasting and therapeutic hypothesis generation
abstract: arXiv:2609.14709v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Immune therapies act across cell-intrinsic programs, tissue ecosystems, and patient-specific immune states, yet most predictors address these scales separately. We used a governed evolutionary AI Scientist to construct the Immune World Model, an action-conditioned model that learns how interventions move immune states across cellular, tissue, and individual levels. The Immune World Model--building Scientist searched candidate architectures and workflows, and the resulting world model was frozen before independent confirmation. The frozen model generalized to unseen interventions and biological contexts, recovered intervention-specific cellular programs, integrated cell and tissue information to improve ecosystem and patient-response prediction, and forecast unseen perturbation combinations. Immune World Model--guided analysis then combined measured perturbations with cross-axis inference to nominate IL-36$\gamma$ plus SIRP$\alpha$ inhibi

translated_title: 用于多尺度预测与治疗假设生成的免疫系统世界模型
translated_abstract: 免疫疗法作用于细胞内在程序、组织生态系统以及患者特异性免疫状态等多个层面，然而大多数预测方法将这些尺度分开单独处理。我们利用一个受治理的进化式AI科学家构建了免疫系统世界模型，这是一个动作条件模型，能够学习干预措施如何在细胞、组织和个体层面改变免疫状态。免疫系统世界模型构建科学家搜索了候选架构和工作流程，所得的世界模型在独立验证之前被冻结。该冻结后的模型能够泛化到未见过的干预措施和生物学情境，恢复干预特异性的细胞程序，整合细胞和组织信息以改进生态系统及患者反应的预测，并预测未见过的扰动组合。免疫系统世界模型引导的分析进一步将已测量的扰动与跨轴推断相结合，提出了IL-36γ联合SIRPα抑制的治疗建议（原文摘要至此处截断）。
tldr: 该研究构建了一个跨细胞、组织和患者个体多尺度的免疫系统世界模型，能够预测干预措施对免疫状态的影响、泛化到未见过的扰动组合，并自动生成治疗假设（如IL-36γ联合SIRPα抑制）。
en_tdlr: This work introduces an Immune World Model that forecasts how interventions move immune states across cellular, tissue, and patient scales, generalizes to unseen perturbations, and automatically generates therapeutic hypotheses such as IL-36γ plus SIRPα inhibition.
